title: Round-trip against MinIO in the shared sample-app fixture; five local probes pass end-to-end
asA: gate reviewer running the ship gate for object-storage-s3 in CI
iWant: the five local Node-only probes to pass against a real MinIO container brought up from the shared infra-s3-and-queue fixture
soThat: every runtime-observable AC has a live-engine verdict on file at ship time

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given docker compose up -d minio from packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/infra-s3-and-queue/, when each of the five run-<probe>.mjs shims runs in sequence (facade-round-trip, put-get-round-trip, presigned-url, multipart-upload, event-secrecy), then each shim exits 0 and writes .rcf/reports/blueprints/object-storage-s3/<probe>.json with aggregateVerdict pass; every result carries an anchorAcId matching a contributed AC id on the blueprint.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the shared fixture with docker compose up -d minio running and MinIO healthy on port 9000
acceptanceCriteria.when: run-facade-round-trip.mjs, run-put-get-round-trip.mjs, run-presigned-url.mjs, run-multipart-upload.mjs, run-event-secrecy.mjs run in sequence
acceptanceCriteria.then: each shim exits 0; each per-blueprint report at .rcf/reports/blueprints/object-storage-s3/<probe>.json carries aggregateVerdict pass; every result carries an anchorAcId matching a contributed AC id

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the shared fixture, when each of the four wired induced-failure switches is set (SIMULATE_MINIO_DOWN, SIMULATE_403_ON_GET, SIMULATE_PART_UPLOAD_FAIL, SIMULATE_PRESIGN_MALFORMED) and the paired probe runs, then that probe's aggregate verdict flips from pass to fail on the AC anchored to the observation the switch corrupts.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the shared fixture with MinIO running
acceptanceCriteria.when: each induced-failure switch is set in turn and the paired probe runs
acceptanceCriteria.then: the paired probe exits non-zero and the aggregate verdict lands as fail on the anchored AC; the fixture README documents the paired switch and probe for each of the four wired switches
